title: Operations
subtitle: Coordination, structure, and mission flow
intro: Operations makes sure missions remain not only exciting, but also coordinated, practical, and understandable. This department connects planning, communication, and onboard organization with the daily functioning of the ship.
missionExamples: Aligning Engineering, Science, and Medical priorities
cultureText: Operations is the place for people who like having an overview and refuse to let chaos run the ship. Anyone who enjoys coordinating, thinking ahead, and turning ideas into working structure will fit in well here.
